notes.title: New stage & save update!
notes.content:
Main update!

- A new stage and Monsters have been added!
(The gameplay is getting longer and traps and creepy dungeons are waiting for you!)

- Now, each stage is saved. (Autosaved when a player arrives at next stage)

We are in a difficult situation as small indie developers, but we will continue to update as possible to provide a better game.

We will be a developer who works harder for players.

Thank you for playing our game.

notes.title: Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
We have modified the system(invisible wall) that pushes the player.
Some bugs are fixed.
Thank you.

notes.title: Updates
notes.content:
Hello

Today's updates.

- Fixed bugs and inconveniences.
- The brightness has been adjusted to make the hints in the game more noticeable.
- We've optimized the game to make it run smoothly.
- The speed of movement of the player has been adjusted.
- The "healing beads (yellow)" from the witch in the battle against the final witch will fill you up HP more.

notes.title: Movement fix & Updates
notes.content:
Hello.

- Slow walking problem on 'HTC VIVE' and 'VIVE COSMOS' devices has been fixed.
(It can happen very little depending on your computer's specifications, but you can enjoy the game enough.)

- The hints have been changed to make them more visible.
- The lantern angle has been comfortably fixed.
- The battle of Erina became a little easier.

Thank you.

notes.title: Save & Updates
notes.content:
Hello!

Save function has been updated.

- The game is automatically saved once on the second floor of the mansion.
- Some bugs have been fixed.
- The last boss, Erina, is a little easier than before.

Thank you.
